items.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: In California my junior high school teacher, who had pushed me from the trumpet to the French horn, needed some bass players for the school orchestra

ctx.x: You played brass instruments and then did someone like put you to the bass for some reason?

Yes. Yes. In California my junior high school teacher, who had pushed me from the trumpet to the French horn, needed some bass players for the school orchestra for the summer school, as I was going from junior high school to Monterey High School. But we were rehearsing in the high school. So he came to me and he said, “I need bass players, are you interested?” And I said — I thought about it — but he knew if I said yes then I’d take the bass home, practice it well enough to get past the concert, because I was…
And you got a degree in sociology?
